meta.oracle: apps/desktop/scripts/markdown-oracle (Electron converter run in place; gray-matter 4.0.3, js-yaml 3.15.1)
meta.note: Function-level cases of the marker layers of packages/shared (block-markers, block-colors, inline-colors, task-block, plain-checkbox, obsidian-tasks, link-card-marker).
meta.yamlJsonEncoding: Numbers that JSON cannot carry are {"$num": "NaN"|"Infinity"|"-Infinity"|"-0"}, a Date is {"$date": ISO}, a Buffer is {"$bin": base64}, a map with a "$"-prefixed key is wrapped as {"$map": {...}}. Key order is Object.keys order.
